$comment: Structured mirror of DOCS/CANDIDATES.md, generated 2026-09-05 during M0. This is real M0 research output (not mock data): candidate scorecards for migration-task feasibility, not an admitted benchmark. Consumed by console/ (dev test frontend, Migration Candidates panel). Edit DOCS/CANDIDATES.md as the prose source of truth; keep this file in sync by hand until a real generator exists (none is planned before Phase 6).
